title: Capability evolution guidance and deterministic conversion coverage controls

surfaces.currentBehavior: Deterministically assigns every Swift service/Auth file and MCP source module in the configured scope to an initial user or operational capability, records source hashes, declared symbols and lexical coupling/read/write/observation/offline signals, and fails generation/checking when any source is unassigned or artifacts are stale.

acceptance: All 41 Swift service/Auth and 47 MCP source files are assigned
An unassigned or changed in-scope source fails generation/checking until reviewed

surfaces.notes: Capability assignment is source triage, not target port/schema approval.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Discovers repository-backed conversion surfaces, including the isolated Ledger target app/core/tests, separately isolated target composition, migration-core and test-support modules/tests, target MCP TypeScript projections, target contract configuration/resources, and the two explicitly configured target query-port inventory control leaves; applies bounded classification batches; detects disappearance and live source drift; validates evidence requirements, product authority and vertical-slice implementation dossiers; emits coverage/authority/slice audits; and enforces cumulative M0-M5 gates. Target query-port control leaves are excluded from Firebase audit/repair discovery even when their contract prose names Firestore exclusions. Initial acknowledgment remains one-time; deliberate re-acknowledgment requires an exact reviewed acknowledgeSourceHash that matches the newly observed hash.

tests: generated product-authority and implementation-slice JSON/Markdown freshness checks
intentional live source-hash drift negative check
acceptance: Discovery and validation complete with zero structural errors or warnings
Every surface resolves through exactly one classification batch to reviewed product or technical authorities
Every registered canonical target spec appears in the reviewed crosswalk and stale generated authority artifacts fail checking
A target slice cannot reach ready without exact authority requirements, complete contract applicability and derived verification obligations
A target surface cannot advance to implemented or later without exactly one correspondingly advanced slice with required evidence
A source edit made after manifest synchronization fails checking
Incomplete M0 exits nonzero with cumulative blockers

surfaces.notes: The explicit hash workflow prevents agents from silently blessing source drift after a characterized file changes. Product-authority roles prevent current or historical Firebase-era specs from silently becoming redesigned target authority. Slice gates prevent implementation/status claims from outrunning exact requirements, contracts, verification and evidence. Separate composition, migration-control and test-support module roots are discovered without placing any of them into Firebase runtime authority. Its deliberate READY change adds exact CONFIG discovery for the target query-port generator/test scaffolds and prevents false Firebase-tool duplication; status and ownership remain unchanged.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Dependency-free deterministic Node lexical scanner that recursively inventories every direct instance-method requirement in every public LedgerTargetCore protocol ending exactly Querying, masks nested ordinary/multiline/raw strings and regex literals without declaration leakage, uses already-masked lexical context to distinguish regex from division across comments, preserves split multiline return types through direct-member boundaries, validates declaration prefixes plus protocol-header, generic-parameter, parameter-clause and function-tail grammar recursively through nonempty nested types with valid component start/end states, rejects unsupported non-ASCII code tokens, emits stable timestamp-free JSON/Markdown with separate identity and signature drift, and fails closed on malformed, ambiguous, duplicate, unsupported or invalid-owner input; check byte-compares both artifacts without writing.

Local generation/checking emits the reviewed 16-owner/16-protocol/18-method inventory; immutable implementation CI remains required before verification.
